observations: SetName constructs a NUL-terminated name, trims right then left with native trim set; accepts nonempty result even unchanged. Changed name updates parent title using active-view identity and invokes application view notification.

SetTraceImage deletes old loaded trace first. Nonempty filename allocates new runtime trace, copies plane/dimensions/hidden/filter. Visible replacement invokes real filename/gray-scale loading; failure returns before stored trace metadata assignment and redraw/document notifications. Hidden replacement skips loading.

SetWallpaperImage deletes old runtime wallpaper first. Nonempty filename creates image, records gray/hidden, and visible replacement calls real resize/decode with current dimensions. Failure returns before stored metadata assignment and parent redraw/document effects.

Legacy display mode honors a global force-wireframe flag, maps modes2/3 or default1 through configured display objects/UUIDs and delegates to UUID SetDisplayMode. Full UUID pipeline still needs detailed policy comparison/implementation.

UUID display setter resolves attributes plus registered pipeline, falling back to configured wireframe if needed. A changed resolved nonnil ID is stored before serial/cache refresh; cache failure can reportfalse after state changes. Parent-dependent display-pipeline rebuild and notification callbacks occur later, with old/new IDs passed to an observer. These are real renderer lifecycle requirements, not an enum-only update.
limits: Static original bodies only, no original runtime or image decoding evidence.
Empty filename/hidden/load-failure/destruction order must have real local assets and renderer effects; no placeholder loaded-image success.
Actual parent title/application notification, image rendering/resize and display-mode SDK/plugin behavior remain unimplemented; these records do not close SetView/Pop/UI/PC/physical parity.
